items.label: Sequential data set
items.effect: Stores records in deterministic sequential order.

items.label: Partitioned data set
items.effect: Owns a bounded member directory and member record streams.

items.label: Partitioned data set extended
items.effect: Owns PDSE members, generations, aliases, and program-object metadata.

items.label: Key-sequenced data set
items.effect: Orders unique primary keys and atomically maintains alternate indexes.

items.label: Entry-sequenced data set
items.effect: Preserves arrival order and stable relative byte addresses.

items.label: Fixed relative record data set
items.effect: Maps fixed slots to one-based relative record numbers.

items.label: Variable relative record data set
items.effect: Maps variable-length records to one-based relative record numbers.

items.label: Linear data set
items.effect: Exposes bounded byte ranges without record interpretation.

items.label: Generation data group
items.effect: Selects and rolls deterministic absolute and relative generations.

items.label: Catalog alias
items.effect: Resolves an alternate catalog name through the shared dependency graph.

items.label: User catalog
items.effect: Owns a bounded catalog namespace selected by catalog search order.

items.label: Master catalog
items.effect: Owns the root catalog namespace and user-catalog connectors.

items.label: Key access
items.effect: Locates exact or generic primary and alternate keys.

items.label: Relative byte address access
items.effect: Reads and positions ESDS or LDS content by stable byte address.

items.label: Relative record number access
items.effect: Reads and mutates RRDS slots by one-based record number.

items.label: Sequential access
items.effect: Reads deterministic forward or reverse record sequences.

items.label: Partitioned member access
items.effect: Resolves members, member generations, and aliases within one directory authority.

items.label: Data set organization
items.effect: Selects an owned organization with organization-specific invariants.

items.label: Record format
items.effect: Selects F, FB, FBS, V, VB, VS, VBS, or U record validation.

items.label: Logical record length
items.effect: Bounds logical record bytes and fixed-record exact length.

items.label: Block size
items.effect: Controls deterministic block allocation and validates fixed blocking.

items.label: Primary key length
items.effect: Selects the bounded key slice used by keyed access.

items.label: Primary key offset
items.effect: Selects the zero-based key displacement within each record.

items.label: Coded character set
items.effect: Records the data encoding identity used at text conversion boundaries.

items.label: Buffer count
items.effect: Bounds the provider buffer reservation requested by the caller.

items.label: Buffer size
items.effect: Bounds each logical access buffer without changing record bytes.

items.label: Spanned records
items.effect: Allows a logical variable record to span control intervals while retaining exact bytes.

items.label: Undefined records
items.effect: Preserves caller-supplied byte units without fixed or variable length interpretation.

items.label: Line records
items.effect: Preserves bounded text records without embedded record delimiters.

items.label: Space unit
items.effect: Selects the deterministic unit used to calculate allocated capacity.

items.label: Primary space
items.effect: Reserves the initial bounded allocation before catalog publication.

items.label: Secondary space
items.effect: Controls bounded deterministic extension after primary capacity.

items.label: Directory blocks
items.effect: Bounds PDS or PDSE directory capacity.

items.label: Release unused space
items.effect: Releases unused secondary allocation at lifecycle close.

items.label: Contiguous allocation
items.effect: Requires one deterministic abstract extent or explicit physical capability.

items.label: Cylinder rounding
items.effect: Rounds abstract allocation to the deterministic cylinder unit.

items.label: Unit count
items.effect: Bounds the number of allocation devices requested.

items.label: Normal disposition
items.effect: Applies the declared catalog and cleanup action after normal completion.

items.label: Abnormal disposition
items.effect: Applies the declared cleanup action atomically after abnormal completion.

items.label: Multivolume allocation
items.effect: Maps ordered extents only when the provider declares the required physical-volume capability.

items.label: Direct allocation
items.effect: Creates allocation and catalog state through the same atomic dataset authority.

items.label: Data class
items.effect: Records the selected data-class identity and its applied defaults.

items.label: Management class
items.effect: Selects retained lifecycle and backup policy metadata.

items.label: Storage class
items.effect: Selects deterministic abstract placement or an explicit provider capability.

items.label: Automatic class selection
items.effect: Runs a declared ACS adapter or returns an explicit unsupported capability.

items.label: Guaranteed space
items.effect: Fails allocation before publication unless full declared capacity is reserved.

items.label: Extended format
items.effect: Selects extended-format metadata needed by compression and striping.

items.label: Extended addressability
items.effect: Selects widened deterministic RBA bounds.

items.label: Data compression
items.effect: Uses a declared compression adapter or returns an explicit unsupported capability.

items.label: Data set encryption
items.effect: Uses a secret-reference encryption adapter or returns an explicit unsupported capability.

items.label: Deterministic abstract volume
items.effect: Provides deterministic capacity and extent behavior without claiming physical placement.

items.label: Physical disk volume
items.effect: Requires a declared physical-volume adapter capability.

items.label: Tape volume
items.effect: Requires a declared tape and library adapter capability.

items.label: Volume table of contents
items.effect: Lists deterministic allocation extents through the volume authority.

items.label: Tape library entry
items.effect: Persists library metadata only when the tape adapter declares its capability.

items.label: Tape volume entry
items.effect: Persists volume metadata only when the tape adapter declares its capability.

items.label: Data striping
items.effect: Requires a declared striping capability and never infers striping from multiple objects.

items.label: Extent ordering
items.effect: Owns deterministic volume and extent order at the contract boundary.

items.label: Catalog search order
items.effect: Resolves master, user, alias, and explicit catalogs in command-specific order.

items.label: Alias resolution
items.effect: Resolves bounded acyclic alias chains with deterministic invalidation.

items.label: Alternate index relation
items.effect: Owns base and alternate-index dependency and upgrade policy.

items.label: Path relation
items.effect: Resolves path access over an alternate index or base cluster.

items.label: Generation selection
items.effect: Resolves relative generations and atomic roll-in cleanup.

items.label: User catalog routing
items.effect: Routes catalog entries through user-catalog connectors.

items.label: Master catalog routing
items.effect: Routes root entries and catalog connectors through the master catalog.

items.label: Catalog owner
items.effect: Records and validates the catalog owner principal identity.

items.label: Expiration and retention
items.effect: Controls delete eligibility using one unambiguous date or retention form.

items.label: Catalog rename
items.effect: Moves the entry and invalidates dependent lookups atomically.

items.label: Catalog listing
items.effect: Lists bounded sorted catalog entries with exact type metadata.

items.label: Dependency invalidation
items.effect: Invalidates alias, path, AIX, GDG, and migration dependents through the shared graph.

items.label: Allocated state
items.effect: Reserves capacity before any catalog-visible success.

items.label: Cataloged state
items.effect: Publishes the dataset definition through one atomic catalog mutation.

items.label: Open state
items.effect: Acquires declared sharing and record-lock resources.

items.label: Closed state
items.effect: Releases locks, applies release policy, and records the final high-used address.

items.label: Recovery-required state
items.effect: Blocks ordinary update until deterministic reconciliation succeeds.

items.label: Migration
items.effect: Moves content through an artifact adapter capability while catalog state remains authoritative.

items.label: Recall
items.effect: Restores migrated content through an artifact adapter capability before reopening.

items.label: Backup
items.effect: Captures a digest-verified provider-neutral definition and content snapshot.

items.label: Restore
items.effect: Validates and atomically selects a compatible snapshot generation.

items.label: Delete cleanup
items.effect: Deletes base, index, allocation, catalog, lock, and lifecycle state atomically.

items.label: Abstract volumes
items.effect: Advertises deterministic in-provider volume behavior.

items.label: Allocation extents
items.effect: Advertises secondary extent and release behavior only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Buffering policies
items.effect: Advertises explicit buffer reservation and sharing only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Extended catalog metadata
items.effect: Advertises extended catalog mutation only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Catalog routing
items.effect: Resolves explicit, aliased, user, and master catalog selection through the catalog authority.

items.label: Control intervals and areas
items.effect: Advertises CI and CA behavior only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Extended format and addressability
items.effect: Advertises extended format and addressability only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Physical volumes
items.effect: Advertises real physical placement only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Tape
items.effect: Advertises tape library and volume behavior only through an implemented capability.

items.label: SMS ACS
items.effect: Advertises automatic class selection only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Encryption
items.effect: Advertises at-rest encryption only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Compression
items.effect: Advertises compatible compression only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Striping
items.effect: Advertises compatible striping only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Migration and recall
items.effect: Advertises artifact-backed migration and recall only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Record-level sharing
items.effect: Advertises the RLS capability only after lock semantics pass.

items.label: SHAREOPTIONS
items.effect: Advertises non-default cross-region and cross-system sharing only through an implemented capability.

items.label: SMS class semantics
items.effect: Advertises SMS class defaulting and placement only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Transactional VSAM
items.effect: Advertises the TVS capability only after UOW and recovery semantics pass.

items.label: VSAM data options
items.effect: Advertises non-default VSAM data options only through an implemented capability.

items.label: Capability diagnostics
items.effect: Returns the exact unavailable capability and affected operand.

items.label: ALLOCATE
items.effect: Allocates VSAM or non-VSAM data sets through typed allocation.

items.label: ALTER
items.effect: Alters supported catalog and dataset attributes atomically.

items.label: ALTER LIBRARYENTRY
items.effect: Alters a tape library entry or reports tape capability unavailable.

items.label: ALTER VOLUMEENTRY
items.effect: Alters a tape volume entry or reports tape capability unavailable.

items.label: BLDINDEX
items.effect: Builds an alternate index from the current base records.

items.label: CREATE LIBRARYENTRY
items.effect: Creates a tape library entry or reports tape capability unavailable.

items.label: CREATE VOLUMEENTRY
items.effect: Creates a tape volume entry or reports tape capability unavailable.

items.label: DCOLLECT
items.effect: Collects bounded deterministic dataset, volume, and lifecycle metadata.

items.label: DEFINE ALIAS
items.effect: Defines a catalog alias through the shared dependency graph.

items.label: DEFINE ALTERNATEINDEX
items.effect: Defines a typed alternate-index relation.

items.label: DEFINE CLUSTER
items.effect: Defines KSDS, ESDS, RRDS, VRRDS, or LDS state.

items.label: DEFINE GENERATIONDATAGROUP
items.effect: Defines generation selection and roll-in policy.

items.label: DEFINE NONVSAM
items.effect: Defines a catalog entry for an allocated non-VSAM data set.

items.label: DEFINE PAGESPACE
items.effect: Defines a page-space entry or reports the unavailable paging capability.

items.label: DEFINE PATH
items.effect: Defines a path over an alternate index or base cluster.

items.label: DEFINE USERCATALOG
items.effect: Defines a user or master catalog and connector state.

items.label: DELETE
items.effect: Deletes catalog, allocation, data, index, and lifecycle state consistently.

items.label: DIAGNOSE
items.effect: Validates catalog and volume structures and reports exact diagnostics.

items.label: EXAMINE
items.effect: Analyzes structural consistency of KSDS data and index state.

items.label: EXPORT
items.effect: Exports a digest-verified provider-neutral snapshot.

items.label: EXPORT DISCONNECT
items.effect: Disconnects a user catalog after snapshot validation.

items.label: IMPORT
items.effect: Imports and validates a provider-neutral snapshot before selection.

items.label: IMPORT CONNECT
items.effect: Connects a validated user or volume catalog.

items.label: LISTCAT
items.effect: Lists bounded catalog entries in deterministic order.

items.label: LISTDATA
items.effect: Lists bounded dataset content metadata.

items.label: PRINT
items.effect: Renders bounded dataset records in the selected character or hexadecimal form.

items.label: REPRO
items.effect: Copies exact records or catalog entries through typed authorities.

items.label: RECOVER
items.effect: Reconciles recoverable catalog and dataset state from a validated source.

items.label: SETCACHE
items.effect: Sets declared storage-controller cache policy or reports the capability unavailable.

items.label: SHCDS
items.effect: Lists and controls bounded RLS and TVS recovery state.

items.label: VERIFY
items.effect: Reconciles catalog high-used addresses and interrupted CA reclaim state.
